title: Isolated Browser Use exploration integrated with Playwright and CI
user_story: As the repository owner I want AI-assisted user exploration with reproducible deterministic evidence and no personal browser or paid-cloud dependency.

requirements.description: Only an owned disposable browser, profile and test application origin are permitted
Unavailable exploration, unconfirmed findings and subjective AI success cannot become verified PASS
Existing canonical harness orchestrates risk-aware deterministic regression and optional/required exploration

nonfunctional: No LLM calls for selection, parsing, reporting or retry accounting
Source/environment provenance and bounded console logs
Never delete skills/ or agent/; never weaken 100% release coverage
preconditions: Preserved dirty work and branch SHAs
Pinned GitHub skills selected before implementation
postconditions: CI alone never promotes missing live/scientific qualification
No application Research Harness imports from development infrastructure
dependencies: GitHub Actions hosted runners; real AI requires separately authorized trusted infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: Playwright smoke runs with no LLM
Network and console failure injection produces real artifacts
No personal profiles/cookies or external domains are used
High/critical missing required exploration blocks the applicable gate
Independent acceptance review remains pending until actually performed

scenarios.expected: Remote, file and credentialed URLs are rejected
Concurrent runs never share browser or application state
AI self-report alone cannot confirm acceptance
Low risk needs no mandatory model; high risk does
Step, time and repair limits cannot expand silently
Malformed browser contracts cannot bypass required exploration
Actual disposable HTTP server denies native launches and configuration writes beyond language
Five reusable personas reference existing deterministic suites and disclose unsupported exploratory adapters

recovery: Inspect concise fingerprints; preserve failing evidence; target failed cases then affected suite; max three automatic repair cycles, then stop and report.
test_environment: Disposable directories and local subprocess fixtures; no paid provider calls.

review.method: Same-agent pre-implementation design review; independent critical acceptance review still pending

tdd.scope: Functional RED rejected fractional/string execution bounds incorrectly; corrected type validation passes the same 6 tests. Browser/model integration remains separately unqualified.

browser_acceptance.scope: Qualifies the implemented settings adapter only. Other personas remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_RUN until separate reviewed journeys execute.

additional_tdd.scope: Functional RED/GREEN: malformed browser acceptance fields previously bypassed validation.
Functional RED/GREEN before integration-file relocation: deleting the private canary was not blocked; mutation audit now denies it. Latest integration run is required for current source.
